en: Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three horizontal photographs. The top image shows a large old manor complex with a tower and outbuildings, labeled in script. The middle image is a wide rural landscape view of a village with fields and trees, also labeled. The bottom image shows a fenced building that looks like a village school next to trees and a half‑timbered house, with a caption beneath. The captions are in German.
